title: ident/change/v1
description: A track's identification block, emitted on its own when its status, reason or mismatch changes (spec 04 §3.2: carried inside every track/telemetry/v1 and emitted on its own when it changes). Internal to this system, on ident.v1.<track_id> (JetStream IDENT, 24 h; docs/PLAN.md §6), in the 04 §2 envelope with the times of the track message that carried the change. Owned by uspace-authority (WP-8): no shared schema exists for the standalone block (a spec gap recorded in the WP-8 pull request). `identification` and `previous` are the shape of uspace-lab track/telemetry/v1 `$defs/identification` (uspace-core core.Identification).

previous.description: The block this one replaces; null for the first published for the track id since this process started (or since the id left its bounded memory).
